function mmLoader(objAttr, chainId = null, elementType = "script", target = document.body) {
	return new Promise(async function (resolve, reject) {
		let element = document.createElement(elementType);

		for (const property in objAttr) {
			element.setAttribute(property, objAttr[property]);
		}
		let path = objAttr.src || objAttr.href;
		element.onload = async () => {
			await yieldToMain();
			resolve(element);
			console.log(`[mmLoader] ${path} caricato!`, "chainId_" + chainId + " Time: " + performance.now());
		};
		element.onerror = e => {
			reject(
				new Error(`[mmLoader] Errore sul caricamento di ${path}`)
			);
			console.log(e);
		};
		await yieldToMain();
		target.appendChild(element);

	});
}

function loadJsbyIO (src, targetSelector, rootMargin) {
	let options = {
		root: null,
		rootMargin: rootMargin || "0px",
		threshold: 1.0,
	};

	const callback = (entries, observer) => {
		entries.forEach((entry) => {
		if (entry.isIntersecting) {
			console.log(`[loadJsbyIO] loading ${src} by intersection of ${targetSelector}`);
			mmLoader({
			src: src,
			async: true
			});
			obs.disconnect();
		}
		});
	};

	let obs = new IntersectionObserver(callback, options);
	let target = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
	obs.observe(target);
};

async function yieldToMain () {

}

<script>
/* === Intro AdK: fallback quando lo slot intro Piemme è empty + listener introCanStart ===
   L'orchestrazione Piemme (empty-detection, cap) è in common.js (startIntro).
   Qui: config AdK, caricamento catena AdKaora, funnel GA, startAdkIntro, listener introCanStart.
   Prerequisiti globali: postTcfReady, mmLoader, device, gtag (definiti sopra / in header).
   Il dispatch di 'introCanStart' è nella adv chain (startAdvChain2022, dopo il load di piemme2.min.js). */

/* Intro AdK config (cap/frequency e orchestrazione Piemme in common.js) */
const INTRO_CONFIG = {
	adkQueueSrc: 'https://cdn.adkaora.space/library/dev/feat/onDemand-delivery-hardening/adk-ondemand-queue.js',
	adkInitSrc: 'https://cdn.adkaora.space/piemme/generic/prod/adk-init.js', /* namespace da confermare con Piemme/AdKaora */
	adkInterstitial: { id: 'adk_interstitial', bannerType: 'interstitial-adk' }
};

function getSecondLevelDomain() {
	const hostname = location.hostname;
	const parts = hostname.split('.');
	if (parts.length >= 2) {
		return '.' + parts.slice(-2).join('.');
	}
	return '.' + hostname;
}

const ADK_QUEUE_SRC = INTRO_CONFIG.adkQueueSrc;
const ADK_INIT_SRC = INTRO_CONFIG.adkInitSrc;

function dispatchAdKaoraChainReady() {
	window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainReady = true;
	if (!window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainEventDispatched) {
		window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainEventDispatched = true;
		window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("adkaora:chain-ready", {
			detail: { timestamp: Date.now() }
		}));
	}
}

function loadAdKaoraScriptForIntro() {
	if (window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainReady && window.AdKaora && typeof window.AdKaora.requestAdv === "function") {
		return Promise.resolve();
	}
	if (window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainPromise) {
		return window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainPromise;
	}

	const loadStep = function (src, marker, srcFragment, isReadyCheck) {
		const existing =
			document.querySelector('script[data-ame-adkaora="' + marker + '"]') ||
			document.querySelector('script[src*="' + srcFragment + '"]');

		if (existing) {
			if (isReadyCheck()) {
				return Promise.resolve();
			}
			return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
				existing.addEventListener("load", function () { resolve(); }, { once: true });
				existing.addEventListener("error", function () {
					reject(new Error("adkaora_script_error:" + marker));
				}, { once: true });
			});
		}

		return mmLoader({
			src: src,
			async: true,
			"data-ame-adkaora": marker
		}, "AdkIntroChain");
	};

	const queueReady = function () {
		return window.AdKaora && window.AdKaora.cmd && Array.isArray(window.AdKaora.cmd.loadAdv);
	};
	const initReady = function () {
		return window.AdKaora && typeof window.AdKaora.requestAdv === "function";
	};

	window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainPromise =
		loadStep(ADK_QUEUE_SRC, "ondemand-queue", "adk-ondemand-queue.js", queueReady)
			.then(function () {
				return loadStep(ADK_INIT_SRC, "adk-init", "adk-init.js", initReady);
			})
			.then(dispatchAdKaoraChainReady);

	window.__ameMhAdKaoraScriptPromise = window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainPromise;

	return window.__ameMhAdKaoraChainPromise;
}

function requestAdkInterstitialIntro() {
	if (window.__ameAdkInterstitialRequested) {
		return;
	}
	if (!window.AdKaora || typeof window.AdKaora.requestAdv !== "function") {
		console.warn("[requestAdkInterstitialIntro] AdKaora.requestAdv non disponibile");
		return;
	}
	AdKaora.requestAdv({
		id: INTRO_CONFIG.adkInterstitial.id,
		bannerType: INTRO_CONFIG.adkInterstitial.bannerType
	});
	window.__ameAdkInterstitialRequested = true;
}

function attachAdkInterstitialFallbackListener() {
	if (window.__ameAdkInterstitialListenerAttached) {
		return;
	}
	window.__ameAdkInterstitialListenerAttached = true;

	const onAdkInteractions = function (event) {
		if (
			(event.detail.id === "adk_interstitial_mondadori" || event.detail.id === INTRO_CONFIG.adkInterstitial.id) &&
			(event.detail.isEmpty === false || event.detail.canBeDelivered === true)
		) {
			window.__ameAdkIntroDelivered = true;
			window.incrementIntroCap();
			window.removeEventListener("adkInteractionsEvents", onAdkInteractions);
			return;
		}
		if (
			(event.detail.id === "adk_interstitial_mondadori" || event.detail.id === INTRO_CONFIG.adkInterstitial.id) &&
			(event.detail.isEmpty === true || event.detail.canBeDelivered === false)
		) {
			window.removeEventListener("adkInteractionsEvents", onAdkInteractions);
		}
	};

	window.addEventListener("adkInteractionsEvents", onAdkInteractions);
}

function startAdkIntro() {
	if (window.__ameAdkIntroStarted) {
		return;
	}
	window.__ameAdkIntroStarted = true;

	if (typeof device === "undefined") {
		return;
	}

	attachAdkInterstitialFallbackListener();

	loadAdKaoraScriptForIntro()
		.then(function () {
			requestAdkInterstitialIntro();
		})
		.catch(function (err) {
			console.warn("[startAdkIntro] AdKaora script load failed", err);
		});
}
window.startAdkIntro = startAdkIntro;

/* Listener sull'evento dispatchato dalla adv chain (startAdvChain2022, dopo load piemme2.min.js).
   Nessun gate contesto: su Sorrisi l'adv chain è già gated dal consenso (postTcfReady). */
window.addEventListener('introCanStart', function () {
	if (window.__ameIntroCanStartHandled) {
		return;
	}
	window.__ameIntroCanStartHandled = true;
	postTcfReady(window.startIntro);
});
</script>
